summary.headline: Fractal Q2 FY27 revenue rose 20% YoY to INR 957 crore (crossing $100M), with adjusted EBITDA margin at 16.2% and gross margin down 225 bps to 44%.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations crossed $100 million for the first time, reaching INR 957 crore, up 20% YoY (10% in constant currency) and 5% QoQ. Adjusted EBITDA grew 30% YoY to a 16.2% margin, while net income rose 139% to INR 79 crore, or INR 102 crore excluding the share of Qure.ai losses. Gross margin fell 225 bps YoY to 44% on investment in forward deployed engineers (FDE) and AI talent ahead of growth, and management expects recovery in Q3 and Q4. Growth was led by HLS (+79%) and BFSI (+30%), with CPG slowing to 11% and TMT returning to sequential growth of 6%.

segments.name: CPG and Retail (CPGR)
segments.commentary: Largest vertical; grew 11% YoY, with management citing inflation and client consolidation. Management said the sequential decline was partly seasonal and expects sequential growth in Q3 and Q4.

segments.name: Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS)
segments.commentary: Growth leader at 79% YoY, the third consecutive quarter of strong HLS and BFSI growth.

segments.name: BFSI
segments.commentary: Grew 30% YoY, also with strong growth for three consecutive quarters.

segments.name: TMT
segments.commentary: Grew 6% QoQ after a sequential decline over the prior five quarters; management expects further sequential recovery in Q3 and Q4.

guidance_outlook: Gross margin expected to recover significantly in Q3 and Q4 as wage-hike timing normalises and FDE investment matures; Q1 is typically the seasonal low.
Management expects profitability to improve on both a sequential and YoY basis by Q4 FY27, and says G&A growth should run at about half of revenue growth.
Fractal Alpha expected to approach breakeven by end of FY27 and reach breakeven on its products in FY28.
Public-investor framework: maximise revenue growth while moving adjusted EBITDA toward about 22%.
Product revenue goal of roughly $100 million run rate in about 12 quarters (non-linear).
DSO expected to return to its historical range by end of FY27.
CPG expected to grow sequentially in Q3 and Q4; TMT expected to keep recovering.
Enterprise AI scale-up expected as early as FY28, which management expects to lift revenue per employee.
capex_capacity: R&D of INR 60 crore in Q2 (6.3% of revenue), with most spend on Cogentiq and Asper.ai; INR 40 crore expensed and the rest capitalised.
Build-out of Cogentiq forward deployed engineers and platform FDEs, with senior AI engineering hiring; this drove the gross margin drag.
Management said it is building a large-deals team and considering acqui-hire and AI-engineering M&A; Pricing One (Europe) deal closed in November 2026.
Qure.ai: no further investment planned, since it is an associate at 31.5%.
INR 81 crore of IPO proceeds deployed in Q2, mostly into R&D, in line with the IPO plan.
demand_pricing: Cogentiq licensed revenue is growing; management cites Cogentiq Invoice to Cash and Cogentiq CX as drivers, with frontier-lab partners generating inbound leads.
Client metrics: NPS 76; six clients above $20M each (vs four a year ago); 58 clients above $1M, 20 of them above $5M; about one new client every 10 days.
Revenue mix: 58% input-based, 42% output and outcome-based (including 4% products); entire growth organic.
Revenue per employee rose marginally in INR terms but fell in USD terms, which management attributed to added capacity rather than pricing.
Management said Fractal's deal sizes are growing while tech-services peers' are shrinking, and it is building a team for larger multi-year deals; large deals are not yet a meaningful part of revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Why is growth uneven across verticals (HLS vs CPG), and is it client acceptance or product depth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed the gap to industry dynamics: healthcare and life sciences are benefiting from AI adoption, while CPG faces inflation and consolidation. It also cited deeper solutions in CPG and healthcare.

qa_highlights.question: Is the gross margin drag an investment in research staff or billable staff?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the cost is delivery expense, not research, and reflects senior FDE and AI engineering hires meant to be billed. Wage hikes moved to June shifted most of the impact into Q2, with margins expected to recover in Q3 and Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What are the CPG outlook and G&A trajectory?
qa_highlights.answer: CPG weakness is partly seasonal (the April-June quarter is typically strong) and partly consolidation-related delays, with sequential growth expected in Q3 and Q4. G&A is to grow at roughly half the rate of revenue, while sales spend will ramp.

qa_highlights.question: What is the partnership and large-deal strategy?
qa_highlights.answer: Frontier labs are sending inbound leads, including for Cogentiq CX, and Fractal was Microsoft's Retail and CPG partner of the year. A large-deals team is being built, but large deals are not yet material to revenue.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Fractal Alpha breakeven path and TMT sustainability?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects Alpha to approach breakeven by end of FY27 and break even on products in FY28. TMT is expected to keep growing sequentially, since most of the work is with commercial teams rather than engineering.

qa_highlights.question: How does the company balance growth and profitability with M&A?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is targeting revenue growth while moving EBITDA toward 22%, and says M&A is aimed at improving right to win, with several deals in the pipeline and cash to fund them.

risks_watch: Gross margin recovery in Q3 and Q4 depends on FDE utilisation and wage-hike timing; Q2 was 44%.
DSO rose to 76 days; management expects normalisation by year-end.
CPG growth of 11% YoY and sequential decline; management has guided to sequential recovery but not to a timeline for strong growth.
Product revenue is 4% of revenue, and the 12-quarter goal implies a steep ramp.
Qure.ai revenue is volatile after USAID funding cuts; the associate's losses drag reported net income.
Revenue per employee declined in USD terms; FDE deployment and billing timing is an open question.
M&A execution and integration, given the pipeline and acqui-hire deals.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, margins and product traction, with a clear profitability timeline; more measured on CPG and on large-deal ramp, which management called early-stage. Responses on Fractal Alpha breakeven and gross margin recovery were specific, though no numeric margin targets were given.
key_quotes: For the first time, our revenue crossed the $100 million threshold.
Net Revenue Retention was 115% in Q2, up from 112% last year, and new clients added another five points of growth.
These are not exactly research investments. These are meant to be billed.
Net-net, we think gross margins will recover quite significantly in Q3 and Q4, and some of these investments are very important investments for when enterprise AI really takes off in a very big way.
We do not invest any further because it is a 31% company.
Right now, that construct is that increase revenue growth as much as possible while taking EBITDA to a 22% level.

growth.why: Management guides to gross margin recovery in Q3/Q4, sequential CPG and TMT growth, and profitability improving by Q4 FY27, backed by Cogentiq and Fractal Alpha traction (products run rate above INR 150 crore, six $20M+ clients) but no quantified revenue guidance or specific capacity additions.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Gross margin fell 225 bps YoY to 44% on FDE and AI hiring, management guided to significant gross margin recovery in Q3 and Q4 and profitability up sequentially and YoY by Q4 FY27, with adjusted EBITDA targeted toward 22% from 16.2%, though no numeric margin targets were given.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Capacity is being added through FDE and senior AI engineering hires plus a large-deals team, and revenue per employee fell in USD terms, but no plant or facility capacity was discussed and no dates were given.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Revenue grew 20% YoY and 5% QoQ to INR 957 crore, with management guiding sequential CPG and TMT growth in Q3 and Q4 and NRR at 115%, though CPG grew only 11% and no numeric volume guidance was given.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex was not discussed beyond R&D of INR 60 crore (6.3% of revenue) and M&A pipeline, and the business is asset-light, so no new capex announcement is signalled; utilisation was not disclosed.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management guided to margin recovery and sequential growth but gave no quantified revenue guidance, so an upgrade would depend on Q3 and Q4 delivery and the 58-client, six-$20M+ client base.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Gross margin at 44% depends on FDE utilisation and wage-hike timing, DSO rose to 76 days from 71, and CPG grew only 11% with consolidation risk.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Products revenue is INR 38 crore (4% of revenue) with a run rate above INR 150 crore, Cogentiq CX and Invoice to Cash are driving growth, and frontier-lab partners are generating inbound leads, but no specific launch dates were given.

rows.label: Europe base via Pricing One deal (Asper.ai)
rows.why: Asper.ai signed a capital-light Pricing One deal, closed in November 2026, to gain a European base, with Europe revenue growing 20% YoY.

rows.label: Fractal Alpha breakeven path
rows.why: Alpha revenue rose 40% YoY to INR 34 crore at 54% gross margin with an adjusted loss of INR 10 crore; management expects it to approach breakeven by end of FY27 and break even on products in FY28.

rows.label: DSO normalisation
rows.why: DSO rose to 76 days from 71 in Q2 FY26 on collection timing, and management expects a return to the historical range by year-end FY27.

tone.note: Management was confident on growth, margin recovery timing, Cogentiq and Fractal Alpha traction, and was measured on CPG and the early-stage large-deal ramp; analysts pushed on the gross margin drag, FDE billing and CPG weakness.
